personal_info.title: Senior Consultant
personal_info.summary: Senior consultant for data platforms and analytics in regulated industries. Ten years of delivery experience from requirements to operations, most recently as architecture and delivery lead of cross-functional teams of four to eight people on Azure-based platforms for banks and insurers.

description: Requirements analysis and data modelling for reporting solutions in banking
Built ETL pipelines and SQL-based reporting for two regional banks
Took over the lead of a three-person analytics team in 2016
Designed and delivered cloud data platforms on Azure for insurance clients
Led agile delivery teams of up to eight people as technical lead
Established data governance and data quality processes with the business departments
Architecture and delivery lead for analytics platforms in banking and insurance
Pre-sales support: solution design, effort estimation and proposals
Focus on business process modelling and database systems
Bachelor thesis on data quality in management reporting
Specialisation in data management and analytics
Master thesis on the automation of regulatory reporting pipelines

projects.title: Regulatory Reporting Data Mart
description: Modelled the data mart for regulatory reports together with the finance and risk departments
Implemented ETL loads in SQL and Python and automated the reconciliation against the source systems
Documented data lineage for the internal audit

projects.title: Reporting Platform Modernisation
description: Replaced a spreadsheet-based reporting landscape with a governed reporting platform
Led a team of three developers; introduced code reviews and automated tests for the loads
Rolled out self-service dashboards to 120 users in controlling and sales

projects.title: Cloud Data Platform for Claims Analytics
description: Designed the Azure-based data platform for claims analytics and led its delivery
Set up infrastructure as code and CI/CD pipelines for the platform team
Built the claims data model and the first fraud indicators with the actuarial department

projects.title: Data Governance and Quality Programme
description: Introduced data ownership, a business glossary and automated quality checks across four domains
Modelled the curated layer with dbt and migrated the loads to Azure Databricks
Reduced the monthly reporting cycle from twelve to four working days

projects.title: Customer Analytics Platform
description: Designed the lakehouse architecture for customer analytics and the integration of eight source systems
Delivered the platform with a team of six in quarterly increments
Built the internal web application for data product owners together with the frontend team

projects.title: Analytics Self-Service Portal
description: Architecture and technical lead for a self-service portal that lets business units publish and consume data products
Defined the API and the data contracts between the portal and the platform
Coached two junior consultants during the delivery
